P. Ā. अपैति, अ॑पायति (impf. Ā. अ॑पायत, RV. x, 72, 6) to go away, withdraw, retire, run away, escape;
to vanish, disappear.
escaped, departed, gone, having retired from, free from (abl. or in comp.)
अपेत—प्रजनन mfn. one who has lost his generative energy, KātyŚr.
अपेत—प्राण mfn. lifeless, Kathās.
अपेत—भी mfn. one whose fear is gone, Mn. vii, 197.
अपेत—राक्षसी f. the plant Ocimum Sanctum (also अप्रेत-र्˚).
Imper. 2
. sg. in comp.) means ‘excluding, expelling’.
अपेहि—प्रघसा (scil. क्रिया) f. a ceremony from which gluttons are excluded, (g. मयूरव्यंसकादि.)
&c. See अपे.
अपेहि—वाणिजा (scil. क्रिया) f. a ceremony from which merchants are excluded, ib.
अपेहि—वाता (scil. लता) f. ‘useful in expelling wind’, the plant Paederia Foetida, Suśr.
